'''Quarren mining laser platforms''' were [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles manufactured by [[Quarren Industrial]]. They were 10 meters long and required one pilot. They could carry one passenger and hover up to one meter above ground. They were equipped with a turreted boring [[Laser/Legends|laser]] behind a safety shield. The pilot sat in a cabin entered by a hatch on the rear bulkhead.
